'''''Pleroma heteromallum''''', [[Synonym (taxonomy)|synonyms]] including '''''Tibouchina grandifolia''''' and '''''Tibouchina heteromalla''''',<ref name=POWO_574812-1/> known by the common name '''silverleafed princess flower''' in English,<ref>{{PLANTS|id=TIHE4|taxon=Tibouchina heteromalla|accessdate=10 December 2015}}</ref> is a species of [[evergreen]] [[flowering plant]] in the family [[Melastomataceae]]. It is native to [[French Guiana]], [[Bolivia]] and [[Brazil]].<ref name=POWO_574812-1/>

==Description==
''Pleroma heteromallum'' reaches an average height of {{convert|4-6|feet|meters||abbr=}}, with a maximum of about {{convert|8-10|feet|m|abbr=}} in its native habitat. The branching stem is woody and the large, silvery green leaves are simple, ovate, velvety in texture, and oppositely arranged. The inflorescence is a [[panicle]] of several purple flowers with five petals. The plant has {{Convert|4-6|inch|cm|abbr=}} long leaves, with prominent veins that are puffed up in the middle and old leaves will often turn an orange color just prior to dropping off.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.smgrowers.com/products/plants/plantdisplay.asp?plant_id=2046|title=Tibouchina heteromalla, Silver leafed Princess Flower, Shrub, [Tibouchina grandifolia, Hort]|website=Plant Information|access-date=2020-02-08}}</ref>

==Cultivation==
The plant is cultivated as an [[ornamental plant|ornamental]] for its showy foliage and purple flowers. It is sensitive to cold but can tolerate a light frost.
